sources.snippet: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 This is a sentence-transformers model: It maps sentences & paragraphs to a 384 dimensional dense vector space and can be used for tasks like clustering or semantic search. sources.title: GitHub - henrytanner52/all-MiniLM-L6-v2
sources.snippet: The project aims to train sentence embedding models on very large sentence level datasets using a self-supervised contrastive learning objective. We used the pretrained nreimers/MiniLM-L6-H384-uncased model and fine-tuned in on a 1B sentence pairs dataset.

sources.snippet: All-MiniLM-L6-v2 is a compact sentence embedding model from the Sentence Transformers project, featuring 22.7 million parameters and generating 384-dimensional vector representations.
